folds.heading: ## Current presence check, 2026-11-04 (B73)
folds.body: A read-only `show` check found `rea` not ready because its declared `/Users/weiwei/code/rea/node_modules` dependency is missing. This qualifies the earlier immediate-shell-access and current-verification wording: the October 21 update/provider/MCP checks remain historical evidence, not a fresh working installation. `show cpp2il` and `show rea-pinned` found their required paths present; no version/health probe, provider/server launch or target analysis was run, so those observations establish presence only. Preserve the distinct updated versus patched-pinned analysis identities; no automatic fallback or transfer of repaired projects is implied. The existing launcher reports the missing default dependency correctly. No dependency installation, tool update, config change, remote access or source recovery is selected by this reconciliation (AD32/AD36).

folds.heading: ## Later presence drift, 2026-11-04 (B73)
folds.body: F1–F5 remain the historical repair/update/configuration receipt. The [current registry presence check](../../TOOL_REGISTRY.md#current-presence-check-2026-11-04-b73) now reports the default REA dependency directory missing, while pinned REA/Cpp2IL required paths are present. That is a current readiness limitation, not a reversal of the recorded successful native fixture/declaration recovery or a reason to silently substitute analysis identities. No health/target/MCP trial or install was performed here. Preserve upstream/signed-byte distinction, declaration-versus-body limits, exact source identities and scoped source authorization (AD32/AD36).
